consent.title: Minimal usage statistics
consent.body: Help us understand how TravStats is used. We send minimal metrics only — version, enabled areas and how much each is used, always as coarse ranges. Reports are linked by a random installation ID, so they are pseudonymous. Never your flights, ports, names, or API keys. Your IP address is transmitted for technical reasons but not stored.
consent.revokeHint: You can turn this off again at any time in the admin area. Turning it off deletes this installation's stored data.
consent.saveFailed: Your choice could not be saved. Please try again.

admin.title: Minimal usage statistics
admin.description: Sends one pseudonymous metrics report per day to stats.travstats.de. Off by default.
admin.installIdHint: Random identifier for this installation. Quote it in an access or erasure request.
admin.endpointDisabled: The endpoint is disabled via environment variable. Nothing is sent.
